modern: About fame: look at the minds of those who seek fame, observe what they are, and what kind of things they avoid, and what kind of things they pursue. And consider that, as heaps of sand piled on one another hide the earlier sands, so in life the events which go before are soon covered by those which come after.

explained.summary: On fame: look closely at the minds of people who crave it, at what they avoid and what they chase, and you may not want their approval. And remember how dunes of sand bury earlier layers: each new event quickly covers the ones before it, and so will your moment of renown be buried.
explained.today: A viral post is forgotten within days, buried by the next one. And the people whose likes you’re refreshing for are usually just as anxious about their own.
